verdict.rationale: Kit supports scheduling one-time broadcasts and offers 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and RSS campaigns (which are inherently recurring), but there's no evidence of an AI-native (API/MCP) mechanism to schedule or manage recurring workflows—broadcast scheduling is single-send and automations are event-triggered rather than time-based recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP support for recurring/cron-style workflow scheduling, documentation of recurring automation triggers, and independent confirmation these can be set up via AI-native tooling.
